votes.motion: Council Member Gerber moved to approve the City Council meeting minutes from
Council Member Henney moved to approve the Consent Agenda

Council Member Joyce moved to approve Ordinance No. 2021-06, an ordinance amending Footnote 2 of Land Management Code Section 15-2.1-2(B)(1) to establish nightly rentals as a conditional use in the Lower Rossi Hill Sub-Neighborhood of the Historic Residential Low-Density Zoning District

Council Member Joyce moved to continue Ordinance 2021-07, an ordinance amending Title 11, Building and Building Regulations Code Section 11-6 Flood Damage Prevention for establishing the areas of special flood hazard of the Municipal Code of

Council Member Joyce moved to grant the following easements, in a form approved by the City Attorney, across City-owned property to the Snyderville Basin Water Reclamation District (SBWRD): 1) two access easements for the existing ‘Silver Creek’ sewer trunk line located near Highway 40 and Park City Heights; and 2) a utility, access, and maintenance easement for a new sewer line for the Lilac Hill East Subdivision, located near Deer Valley Drive and Rossi Hill Road
Council Member Doilney moved to approve emergency contingency funding in the amount of $170,000 to acquire emergency services to mitigate community impacts of COVID-19
